name: PagerDuty
summary: Incident response platform: monitoring events in, deduplicated by key, grouped into incidents, routed by rules to a service, and paged to whoever is on call under that service's escalation policy. For agents: a hosted MCP server (API token or OAuth) whose documented tools include write actions, and a REST API. Its '91% noise reduction' comes from a commissioned 2024 Forrester study of one composite customer, and later pages restate it as an AIOps result.

payments.notes: Read 2026-11-12: Free $0 (5 users, one escalation policy, no MCP); Professional $21/user/month annually, AIOps add-on separate; PD Reliability Platform Starter $2,800, Essential $12,000, Plus $48,000 a year, Ultimate custom. Grouping needs AIOps on Professional. Nothing prices a call.

agentAccess.notes: MCP mcp.pagerduty.com/mcp: keyless initialize 401 invalid_token, RFC 9728 metadata, 84 scopes (2026-11-12). Docs: user API token or OAuth; account needs Advanced Permissions; 18 tools, 7 manage_* (write); no hosted tool filtering, so scoped OAuth is the only limit.

jobs.summary: Deduplicates by sender-set key, groups alerts into incidents (paid), routes events to services by rules, and pages on-call responders via escalation policies. The 91% noise figure is a commissioned composite, not a measured AIOps rate. Time to acknowledge and misrouting: unpublished.
